Osceola County stretches from the Orlando tourism corridor at Kissimmee and Celebration southeast across open cattle ranch toward the Kissimmee River. It is one of the fastest-growing counties in the country, and its defining feature is scale: single-owner ranch holdings tens of thousands of acres in size, now being master-planned as whole new communities, which makes ownership and entitlement status far more decisive than existing land use.
Source: U.S. Census Bureau · Data verified: October 5, 2026
